    Proposition 2.10(3): dimensions of evaluated modules #

    graded-category.tex (prop:projective-evaluation(3)): "If X₀ is the evaluation of the object labelled by an indecomposable A-module X, then dim_k X₀e_x = dim_k Xe_x […] dim X₀e_x = dim C(P_x, X) = dim Xe_x."

    The evaluation at the projective label P_x is C(P_x, X), of dimension dim Hom_A(P_x, X) (finrank_meshHom, eq. graded-hom-dimensions); for P_x ≅ e_xA, Hom_A(e_xA, X) ≅ Xe_x by evaluation at e_x (homIdealEquiv).
